Resolution criteria:
- "St. Louis Cardinals": Wins if the Cardinals record an official win against the Philadelphia Phillies in their MLB game on August 21, 2026 (UTC).
- "Philadelphia Phillies": Wins if the Phillies record an official win against the St. Louis Cardinals in their MLB game on August 21, 2026 (UTC).

Clarifications:
- The result is determined by the official final score of the MLB-sanctioned game played between these two teams on the specified date, including any extra innings. If a suspended game from a prior date is completed on this date, it does not count; only a game originally scheduled for August 21, 2026 qualifies.
